text:
Eli: Heads-up 10:12 UTC 11 - noticed a sudden jump in 'High renewal risk' counts for small accounts after yesterday's healthscore config update.
Fern: saw a spike in the digest too. was about +9% for 'SMB' segment.
Grace: which change was deployed? I merged the quantile re-bucketing patch last night to stabilize tails.
Eli: I think that re-bucketing moved several accounts from score 62 -> 49 because we shifted percentile cutoffs. Playbooks use absolute thresholds (score < 50 => risk).
ops-bot: :information_source: Deploy 2026-04-05T02:05Z: healthscore-service v4.1.0 by Grace
Fern: short-term mitigation: can we add a mapping layer that keeps legacy thresholds for at-risk cohorts while we evaluate?
Grace: yes - quick patch: use legacy buckets for cohorts with <500 ARR or flagged 'legacy-thresholds' tag. will push as hotfix and run a dry-run for 15m.
Eli: can someone run a delta to quantify how many accounts crossed the <50 boundary due to bucket shift? SQL snippet below:
```
SELECT account_id, score_old, score_new
FROM healthscore.delta_sample
WHERE cohort = 'SMB' AND score_old >= 50 AND score_new < 50
LIMIT 500;
```
Fern: ran it - ~3.4k accounts in SMB; mostly <200 ARR.
Grace: patching now and will exclude SMB from new bucketing until we finish calibration.
Eli: follow-ups: 1) postmortem documenting bucketing rationale; 2) update playbook logic to use percentiles for freshness signals instead of hard cutoffs; 3) alert rule for >2% cohort delta in renewal_risk within 30m.
Fern: agree. adding tasks to the runbook and notifying CS ops to pause any automated renewal outreach for impacted cohorts.
Grace: hotfix deployed at 02:34Z. ops-bot: :white_check_mark: healthscore-service rollback-mode applied for cohort=SMB.
Eli: monitoring now. if metrics look stable after 30m we can schedule a staged recalibration with offline validation. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
